true_evidence: Section 2(68) of the Companies Act, 2013 defines a private company as a company which by its articles restricts the right to transfer its shares and, except in case of a One Person Company, limits the number of its members to two hundred.

Explanatory note on section 2 of the Companies Act, 2013. Under the Companies Act, 2013, a private company must limit the number of its members to two hundred. This is the position under the text of section 2 as currently in force.
false_claim: Under the Companies Act, 2013, a private company must limit the number of its members to fifty.
false_evidence: Section 2(68) of the Companies Act, 2013 defines a private company as a company which by its articles restricts the right to transfer its shares and, except in case of a One Person Company, limits the number of its members to fifty.
